question: Who chairs Council meetings when the Chancellor is not there?

answer.text:
When the Chancellor is not present at a Council meeting, the meeting is presided over by the **chairman of the Council**.  
If the chairman is also absent, the **vice‑chairman of the Council** presides.  

This is stated in the MSU yearbooks:

- **Evidence 1** (MSU Sciences Yearbook Vol. 2, p. 19): “At all meetings of the Council at which the Chancellor is not present the chairman of the Council or, in his absence, the vice‑chairman shall preside.”  
- **Evidence 2** (MSU Humanities Yearbook, p. 18): “At all meetings of the Council at which the Chancellor is not present the chairman of the Council or, in his absence, the vice‑chairman shall preside.”
